name: Republic of South Maluku (1950)
description: A red field with a hoist band of three narrow vertical stripes — blue, white and green.
history: The Republic of South Maluku was proclaimed at Ambon on 25 April 1950 by Moluccans opposed to incorporation into a unitary Indonesia; its flag was hoisted on 2 May 1950. Indonesian forces took Ambon by November 1950 and the last resistance on Seram ended in 1963, after which a government in exile in the Netherlands has kept the flag, which is banned in Indonesia.

features.symbolism: blue for the sea and loyalty, white for purity and the beaches, green for the vegetation
